input:
A junior driver-level engineer reports: 'We moved to LPDDR6 + UFS 4.1 + Linux 6.18 on one SoC as a triple-feature uplift. Now we see random-looking issues: occasional ECC errors, camera burst stutter, and a few sched_ext watchdog trips. PM wants to know ETA.'

Apply the Blackboard convergence approach. How do you decompose this into single-subsystem diagnostic workstreams (LPDDR6 MC, UFS 4.1 WB, sched_ext), what Socratic questions separate 'related issues' from 'coincident issues', and how do you communicate uncertainty to PM without overcommitting to an ETA?
